source: Original SF_DESIGN_PREVIEW log chunks; 37/37 complete, 1-based indexing, zero JSON parse errors.

findings.name: UI44-no-source-scenarios-test-data
findings: Native dark desktop empty-case state visibly reports that the producer has not issued authorized sensitivity units.
Scenario, baseline and parameter controls remain at Choose a case; Unit appears disabled.
The selected case heading and absence notice are legible without overlap.
limits: This is a configure state, not a result or qualification.

findings.name: UI44-original-source-selection-test-data
findings: Native dark desktop shows the selected scenario, baseline and February parameter before requesting units.
The Unit action is visible and enabled; no issued-unit editor or result is shown yet.
Long values are clipped inside native select controls; the full case heading is visible.
limits: Exact source identity is established by the original assertions/readbacks, not by the clipped select text alone.

findings.name: UI44-issued-units-editor-dark-desktop-test-data
findings: Native dark desktop issued editor displays USD / USD and two evidence references.
Criterion uses ≤ 2000; bounds are 200 to 2200 with two steps.
Evaluate sensitivity is visible; the Steps control has a clear focus outline and the lower editor remains within the image.
limits: The image establishes editor configuration only.

findings.name: UI44-issued-units-editor-light-desktop-test-data
findings: Native light desktop retains the same source selections, USD / USD, two evidence references, ≤ 2000 criterion and 200–2200 / 2 bounds.
The complete editor and Evaluate sensitivity action are legible within the captured viewport.
limits: This confirms the displayed light-theme editor state, not a completed evaluation.

findings.name: UI44-issued-units-editor-dark-390-test-data
findings: The 390px dark viewport stacks the case and source controls without visible horizontal page overflow.
The case heading wraps and the Evaluate sensitivity action remains visible.
The capture reaches the parameter control near the lower edge.

findings.name: UI44-issued-units-editor-light-320-test-data
findings: The 320px light viewport keeps the heading, case selection, scenario and baseline controls within the narrow panel.
The case heading wraps and the Evaluate sensitivity action remains visible.
limits: Only the Parameter label is visible near the lower edge; the parameter control and lower editor are outside this capture.

findings.name: UI44-dark-desktop-review-test-data
findings: Native dark desktop review displays wrapped scenario and parameter references, criterion text lte 2000 USD and basis 200–2200 (2) USD.
Confirm sensitivity evaluation and Cancel review are both visible and legible within the review panel.
No result or sample table is displayed.
limits: This is the review before evaluation, not a persisted result.

findings.name: UI44-dark-320-review-actions-test-data
findings: The 320px review wraps the full scenario and parameter references within the panel.
Criterion, basis and both stacked confirmation/cancel actions are visible.
No visible horizontal overflow or overlap affects these captured review contents.
limits: The page is scrolled to review actions; its upper heading is outside this capture.

findings.name: FAILED-native-wave-three-test-data
findings: The failure image visibly reports Lost connection to the server. Retrying... with a Retry now action.
The review remains displayed with the same references, lte 2000 USD and 200–2200 (2) USD basis.

No result or sample table is displayed.
limits: The connection warning does not identify the backend cause or establish whether a mutation persisted.
No response or authenticated sensitivity-result readback was observed.

conclusion: Partial source/editor/review evidence only. UI44 is not qualified because the unchanged declaration failed before evaluation response and result readbacks.

The connection warning does not establish the backend cause or whether the mutation persisted.
